title: Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34653v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $\tau^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downs

translated_title: 听得足够即可行动：口语对话系统中的早期工具调用
translated_abstract: 对延迟敏感的语音代理不仅需要知道调用哪个工具，还需要知道何时听到的信息已足够采取行动。即使请求已经可以执行，等待用户话轮完成也会延迟执行。然而，现有的语音代理和口语对话语料库均未定义请求变为可执行的最早时间点。我们引入了一个合成口语对话流水线，提供最早可执行点监督，标记观察到的语音何时能够确定一个工具及其所需参数。通过受控任务生成、语音合成与对齐以及门控标注，我们构建了26,694个对话，总计786小时，涵盖48个领域，且训练集与测试集的参数值互不相交。我们还创建了τ²-bench的音频渲染版本用于外部评估。我们在此语料库上训练了一个全模态语言模型，使其能够进行因果的、分块级别的决策，并生成部分转录文本用于下游任务。
tldr: 本文提出了一个包含26,694个对话（786小时、48个领域）的合成口语对话语料库，用于训练全模态语言模型在用户话轮尚未结束时即判断“何时听得足够”并提前调用工具，从而降低语音代理的响应延迟。
